name: Hand pressure map
summary: A five-fingered hand seen from the palm: each touch sensor where it is on the hand, coloured from black to white by its pressure, with its reading.
help: Wire a live stream (a Telemetry block, or a block's telemetry) whose items, on the channel named below, carry one number per sensor in newtons: thumb_tip, thumb_mid, thumb_prox (the thumb's metacarpal), index_tip, index_mid, index_prox ... little_prox, and palm_1 to palm_4 (palm_1 the fingers' side by the index, palm_2 the fingers' side by the little finger, palm_3 and palm_4 the wrist side). Optional: grip_n (the grip in all) and holding (1 when holding). Colours go black, blue, cyan, green, yellow, red, white as the pressure grows to the highest value; hover a sensor for its name.

inputs.label: Sensors
inputs.help: Items with one field per sensor (N)

params.label: Channel
params.help: The stream channel with the sensors' readings
